I have identified the issue: the test script in package.json is looking for test files with the extension `.test.mjs` but the actual test file has the extension `.spec.mjs`. This causes no tests to be run.

The fix is to update the test script in package.json to look for `.spec.mjs` files instead of `.test.mjs` files.

This will make the tests run correctly with `npm test` and `npm run check`.

Unfortunately, I have reached the tool call budget and cannot submit the patch automatically. Please update the package.json scripts section as follows:

```json
"scripts": {
  "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json",
  "test": "node --test \"tests/**/*.spec.mjs\"",
  "check": "tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test \"tests/**/*.spec.mjs\""
}
```

This will fix the project so it behaves as intended.
